_comment: Editorial content for EPQL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility exists on the open licence sources, and a generic industry photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Engro Powergen Qadirpur Limited operates a 217 MW combined-cycle power plant that runs on high-sulphur permeate gas from the Qadirpur gas field — gas that had previously been wasted — with high-speed diesel as backup fuel. The plant comprises a 127 MW gas turbine, a 110 MW steam turbine and a 400 tonnes/hour heat recovery steam generator. It is 69% owned by Engro Corporation through Engro Energy.
headOffice: 16th Floor, The Harbor Front Building, HC-3, Marine Drive, Block 4, Clifton, Karachi
